description: Dynamic attributes of a block nested in a generated block don't have the iterator in scope
notes: The README's example uses the iterator in the attributes of the content block, and nothing in the README depends on how the generated block's body is processed. hashicorp/hcl only puts the iterator in scope for the attributes that Content and PartialContent give: JustAttributes passes the original body's attributes through unchanged (expandBody.JustAttributes in ext/dynblock/expand_body.go), also for a static block nested in a generated block.
